edges.description: Moves workflow from agent orchestration toward governed heterogeneous work under canonical ownership.
Moves context/memory/playbooks under bounded-context and minimal-projection discipline rather than parallel control planes.
Authority-before-intelligence and evidence-first architecture constrain assurance/audit promotion semantics.
Runtime ownership and capability/effect boundaries replace vendor-specific runtime semantics in the core.
Routing/reputation/economics remain downstream of authority/eligibility and cannot mint authority.
Protocols become edge projections/adapters rather than kernel ontologies.
Experience becomes a projection/steering surface over canonical state, not an owner of runtime/policy state.
Research remains evidence and cannot silently become canonical architecture.
Logical work produces routing intents, constraints and budget context for realization.
Routing realizes eligible work through concrete execution bindings/runtime candidates.
Effect ambiguity, reconciliation, cancellation and durability constrain retry/replan/workflow lifecycle semantics.
Boundary qualification and semantic-loss accounting constrain execution through external runtimes/protocols.
Canonical effect/reconciliation semantics must be preserved when projected across protocol boundaries.
Project/context evidence and procedural knowledge inform planning and workflow compilation.
Project-local context, priors and applicability inform routing without granting authority.
Context/memory provenance informs what Experience surfaces and how deeply it discloses operational state.
Only qualified outcomes/evidence should update routing/reputation/economic adaptation.
Procedural candidates and workflow optimizations require independent/qualified evidence before durable promotion.
Runtime/sandbox/reliability claims require assurance rather than self-reported success.
Metrology, validity, independence and experimental design calibrate assurance instruments.
Routing claims require baselines, regret/calibration, paired designs and contamination-aware evidence.
Workflow improvements require cost-to-trust and causal/experimental evaluation, not trace anecdotes alone.
Workflow state/progress is projected into human-facing surfaces.
Human steering/approval/repair enters work through governed intents rather than UI-owned state mutation.
Model/runtime/cost/route decisions are surfaced as operational disclosure.
Evidence, confidence, approvals and incidents shape operator-facing explanations and review surfaces.
Exact local chat research summary export.
Reframes identity as compositional lineage across canonical bounded contexts.
Durable Work becomes temporal backbone without making Workflow sole owner of lineage.
Requires Work/Attempt/LogicalEffect/effect settlement distinctions.
Separates provenance, evidence, audit and evaluator lineage.
Requires identity/reference/semantic preservation across boundaries.
Evidence scope/applicability bounds learning and reputation propagation.
Uses ResearchObject/lineage/provenance model on the research repository itself.
